**Finding: compliant (ASSIGN)** — no redline proposed.

Section 24 sits at the preferred position and is favourable to us:
- **24.1** — we may assign to an Affiliate or M&A successor without Vendor consent (prompt notice only).
- **24.2** — Vendor may not assign, delegate material performance, or transfer by change of control without our prior written consent (not unreasonably withheld for a capable assignee), and never to a direct competitor.
- **24.3** — mutual not-unreasonably-withheld/conditioned/delayed standard for other assignments.
- **24.4** — our change of control gives Vendor no right to terminate, suspend, reprice, accelerate Fees, or reduce service; Vendor must cooperate with successor administration.
- **13.3** — licence rights follow a permitted assignment, so no gap between assignment and licence transfer.
